findings.highlight: I was wondering how you survived.
findings.evidenceJa: あの状態でよく持ちこたえた
findings.governingReading: Shirou asks how Rin managed to hold out while caught in Berserker’s grip.
findings.explanation: Survived broadens the question to the entire encounter and weakens the specific duration her defense must explain.

findings.evidenceJa: 笑顔で殺気をみなぎらせる
findings.governingReading: Rin answers with a smile visibly brimming with killing intent.
findings.explanation: Menacing preserves intimidation but suppresses the explicitly lethal comic excess.

findings.governingReading: Rin had spread a protective membrane or barrier using the jewel fixed inside her clothing.
findings.explanation: Cover is materially vague and loses the magical layer she erected around the body.

findings.evidenceJa: なんだかね、なんて溜息をつく
findings.governingReading: Rin sighs with a resigned “what a thing” response to the cost of the battle.
findings.explanation: Wondering why invents a question or failure of understanding absent from her acceptance.

findings.highlight: As she says, I bet her words will come true.
findings.evidenceJa: それと同じように、遠坂の言葉はあっさりと実現するに違いない
findings.governingReading: Because Rin states the ambition so lightly, Shirou believes it will become reality with the same ease.
findings.explanation: As she says drops the parallel between her effortless declaration and his confidence in effortless fulfillment.
